raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Part **8/n** of the Kimi K3 / Dist-MoE training stack. Based directly on `main`; this PR can land independently of the remaining stack.

human notes: fix the nccl ulysses safeguard that uses `Ulysses.Config` instead of `UlyssesInnerAttention.Config`. 

## Why

The existing NCCL Ulysses safeguard detects `UlyssesInnerAttention.Config`.
Compact MLA, Ulysses KDA, and Ulysses GDN instead inherit directly from
`Ulysses.Config`, so these models miss the existing protection on affected
NCCL versions.

Example: `UlyssesMLAAttention.Config` does not inherit from
`UlyssesInnerAttention.Config`. On NCCL 2.32.2 the old traversal leaves graph
registration enabled; traversing the common base selects the existing safeguard.
The NCCL fix and version boundary are unchanged:
[NVIDIA/nccl#2362](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nccl/pull/2362).

## What changed

- Match the common `Ulysses.Config` base in the existing safeguard.
- Add one isolated GDN regression for a subclass outside the old hierarchy.
  Full attention uses K/V all-gather in this test, so it cannot accidentally
  trigger the old safeguard.
- Keep the existing version-boundary and unsupported-runtime tests rather than
  repeating them for each backend.

There are only two production-line replacements. Native attention and
communication paths are unchanged; no new option or dependency is introduced.

## User-facing changes

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| The safeguard detects only full-attention Ulysses wrappers. | It also detects compact MLA and linear-attention Ulysses wrappers. |
| NCCL >= 2.32.3, non-CUDA, and fake runtimes skip the safeguard. | Unchanged. |

## Numerics

No tensor computation, collective implementation, parameter, or checkpoint
layout changes. This extends an existing pre-initialization runtime policy.
The CPU checks below do not claim fresh end-to-end training or throughput
acceptance.

## Testing

Fresh validation against upstream `73c4ebdac57de0d89bb20d5dfabed340449c8b0d`:

- **91 CPU tests and 84 subtests passed**, with no deselection.
- **Fresh negative control:** the retained GDN regression fails on untouched main
  because `NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER` remains unset; it passes with this change.
- All non-type-checking pre-commit hooks passed over all files.

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' python -m pytest -q -o addopts='' -p no:cacheprovider --tb=short \
  tests/unit_tests/cpu/distributed/test_ulysses_nccl.py \
  tests/unit_tests/cpu/models/common/test_cp_attention.py \
  tests/unit_tests/cpu/config/test_context_parallel_validation.py
```

The type error at unchanged
`torchtitan/components/data/multimodal/utils/video.py:114` independently
reproduces on untouched upstream `73c4ebdac`. This PR does not change that file.

Not verified: a fresh real multi-rank CP/CUDA-graph training run.

## Stack

This PR is directly based on `main` and does not require 4/n-7/n. The other
source branches are unchanged by this update.

1/n (#5674) is merged; 2/n (#5675) and 3/n (#5676) are closed.

nodes.body: Can you share more on what this PR is doing?
Hi @fegin, updated the pr description with human notes.
I don't see a human section, lol. But this PR makes sense now.

**Verdict: Approve** -- a two-line fix that points the existing NCCL guard at the base class every Ulysses backend actually shares.

**What this PR does.** `configure_nccl_for_ulysses` sets `NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER=0` on NCCL < 2.32.3 when the model contains Ulysses CP. It looked for `UlyssesInnerAttention.Config`, but `UlyssesMLAAttention`, `UlyssesInnerKDA` and `UlyssesInnerGDN` subclass `Ulysses` directly (`cp_mla.py:83`, `cp_kda.py:42`, `cp_gdn.py:43`). This PR traverses `Ulysses.Config` instead, which covers every current Ulysses backend, plus any future one, with no list to keep up to date.

**Example.**
```
kimi_k3 debugmodel, CP map {MLAAttention: UlyssesMLAAttention, InnerKDA: ContextParallelInnerKDA}
NCCL 2.32.2, device_type="cuda"
before: traverse(UlyssesInnerAttention.Config) -> empty -> NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER unset
after:  traverse(Ulysses.Config) -> UlyssesMLAAttention.Config -> NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER=0
```
Both callers (`training_engine.py:328`, `experiments/torchft/trainer.py:83`) pass the model config, so neither needs a change.

### Should consider
- `tests/unit_tests/cpu/distributed/test_ulysses_nccl.py:56-117` -- the test is 63 lines with three cases that all hit the same `isinstance` check, and the version-boundary assertions repeat an existing test. One case is enough (see the inline comment).

A maintainer (fegin) has already approved.

Consider cutting this down to a single case. The regression it guards is "the traversal matches something narrower than `Ulysses.Config` again", and any one subclass that skips `UlyssesInnerAttention` catches that. Once the guard traverses the base class, `compact_mla`, `kda` and `gdn` all exercise the same `isinstance` check, so the three-way parametrization builds two debug models (kimi_k3 and qwen3_5) and runs the CP transform three times without covering anything extra. The `backend == "compact_mla"` ternaries also make the attention map hard to read.

The version-boundary half (`2.32.3 -> None`) repeats `test_disables_registration_before_fixed_version`. One option: keep only the `gdn` case, which is already a single unambiguous map (`FlexInnerAttention -> AllGatherKV`, `InnerGDN -> UlyssesInnerGDN`), assert `self.configure(model) == "0"`, and drop the parametrization and the version recheck. That leaves about 15 lines. The `ulysses_configs` isinstance assertion that only `UlyssesInnerGDN` is present can stay, since it is what keeps the test from passing on a full-attention Ulysses match.

@@ -53,6 +53,69 @@ def test_disables_registration_before_fixed_version(self):
     def test_skips_non_ulysses_model(self):
         self.assertIsNone(self.configure(self.model))
 
+    @parametrize("backend", ("compact_mla", "kda", "gdn"))
+    def test_disables_registration_for_other_ulysses_backends(self, backend):
+        from torchtitan.config.parallelism import ParallelismConfig
+        from torchtitan.models.common.attention import MLAAttention
+        from torchtitan.models.common.attention.cp_attention import (
+            AllGatherKVFlexInnerAttention,
+            Ulysses,
+        )
+        from torchtitan.models.common.attention.cp_gdn import UlyssesInnerGDN
+        from torchtitan.models.common.attention.cp_kda import (
+            ContextParallelInnerKDA,
+            UlyssesInnerKDA,
+        )
+        from torchtitan.models.common.attention.cp_mla import (
+            AllGatherKVMLAFlexAttention,
+            UlyssesMLAAttention,
+        )
+        from torchtitan.models.common.attention.gdn import InnerGDN
+        from torchtitan.models.common.attention.kda import InnerKDA
+        from torchtitan.models.kimi_k3 import build_model_config as build_kimi_k3
+        from torchtitan.models.qwen3_5 import build_model_config as build_qwen3_5
+
+        if backend == "gdn":
+            model = build_qwen3_5(
+                "debugmodel", attn_backend="flex", parallelism=ParallelismConfig()
+            )
+            attention_map = {
+                FlexInnerAttention: AllGatherKVFlexInnerAttention,
+                InnerGDN: UlyssesInnerGDN,
+            }
+            ulysses_type = UlyssesInnerGDN
+        else:
+            model = build_kimi_k3(
+                "debugmodel", attn_backend="flex", parallelism=ParallelismConfig()
+            )
+            attention_map = {
+                MLAAttention: (
+                    UlyssesMLAAttention
+                    if backend == "compact_mla"
+                    else AllGatherKVMLAFlexAttention
+                ),
+                InnerKDA: (
+                    ContextParallelInnerKDA
+                    if backend == "compact_mla"
+                    else UlyssesInnerKDA
+                ),
+            }
+            ulysses_type = (
+                UlyssesMLAAttention if backend == "compact_mla" else UlyssesInnerKDA
+            )
+        model = ContextParallelTransform(inner_attention_map=attention_map).transform(
+            model
+        )
+        ulysses_configs = [config for _, config, _, _ in model.traverse(Ulysses.Config)]
+        self.assertTrue(ulysses_configs)
+        # Another Ulysses implementation must not mask a missed backend match.
+        self.assertTrue(
+            all(isinstance(config, ulysses_type.Config) for config in ulysses_configs)
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(self.configure(model), "0")
+        os.environ.clear()
+        self.assertIsNone(self.configure(model, version=(2, 32, 3)))
